pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-large-batch
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 53 previously undecompiled PAL resident game functions (5,368 bytes). The batch covers record initialization and updates, table lookups, state transitions, callback dispatch, and argument-forwarding wrappers. Interfaces were checked against retail callees and callers, including forwarded float inputs, packed 64-bit arguments, pointer fields, and returned values.

pullRequests.body:
Summary
Matches 938 more NTSC-U functions in plain C (src/), by carrying over code that is already matched elsewhere in this repository: PAL twins (same function, other disc) and same-game sibling functions (same code in a different level overlay or in the main image). It also retires 436 src/pal/ copies that the new src/ sources now cover on PAL, following the "each function lands once, in src/" convention from docs/levels.md.

shape. The PAL C was compiled for the NTSC-U function and every callee and data symbol was renamed to
the NTSC-U address the retail relocation resolves to; build, audit_matches and the map/progress checks
pass for both versions. progress/report.json and the maps are regenerated.
